purpose: Determine whether the sealed Phase44 four-route Pixel5 development cohort resolves the Phase36 constant-identifiability failure. This is a residual diagnostic only: no truth-derived correction is fitted, applied, selected, or deployed.

objective.candidate_source: Phase44 sealed candidate bytes from the Phase43 structural seal run1 artifacts

warmup_contract.matching: warmup keys absent from sealed candidate remain unmatched; no interpolation, edge hold, nearest match, or fill

coverage_reporting.matched_key_coverage: exact matched candidate/truth keys divided by truth rows
coverage_reporting.truth_row_coverage: truth rows read from the pinned Phase44 materialization divided by freeze-pinned truth rows; this is reported separately and must be 1.0

residual_contract.frame: fixed local ENU at first chronological matched truth coordinate; prediction minus truth ECEF difference rotated at that origin
residual_contract.up: null/unobservable because sealed candidate submission has no altitude; never filled from truth, result, sample, MAT, WLS, or any other coordinate artifact
residual_contract.prediction_altitude_projection: truth altitude is used for both predicted and truth ECEF calls only to project horizontal latitude/longitude error; no up residual is produced
residual_contract.covariance: ordinary unbiased covariance and component-wise 3-MAD inlier covariance
residual_contract.prefix_tail: chronologically sorted matched rows; first and last ceil(25 percent), each nonempty
residual_contract.quartiles: chronologically contiguous four equal-index quartiles using floor boundaries
residual_contract.linear_time_drift: ordinary least-squares east/north residual slope against normalized matched time in [0,1]; endpoint drift is the slope vector
residual_contract.route_median_pairwise_distance: Euclidean horizontal distance in metres between route median ENU vectors

speed_bins.source: sealed candidate consecutive-row Haversine speed only; truth speed is forbidden

loo_common_median.training_estimator: component-wise median of the three non-held route median ENU vectors
loo_common_median.correction: diagnostic residual minus training common median; no corrected coordinates are written and no native inference consumes it
loo_common_median.held_route_score: (P50 + P95) / 2 over corrected fixed-ENU horizontal norms, linear percentile rank (n - 1) * q
loo_common_median.baseline_score: same fixed-ENU horizontal norm score before correction

identifiability_gates.logic: All gates are predeclared and ANDed. A failed or untestable gate means no-go; no threshold may be relaxed after truth is read.

exact_model_route_count.criterion: All four route identities are exact Pixel5 model routes with finite exact-key residuals and truth_row_coverage 1.0.

route_median_center_dispersion.criterion: Component-wise MAD across the four route median vectors is <=0.50 m in each horizontal component and every route median is <=1.00 m from the component-wise common median.

prefix_tail_stability.criterion: Every route prefix-tail median-vector shift is <= max(1.00 m, 2.0 * sqrt(MAD_E^2 + MAD_N^2)).

orientation_independence.criterion: For each required dimension, at least two route/dimension cases have at least two groups with >=20 matched rows, and every comparable group median is <=0.75 m from its route overall median. Orientation labels are raw-only diagnostics and never fit features.

loo_all_route_improvement.criterion: Every held route's diagnostic LOO common-median score improves by at least 0.05 m versus its uncorrected fixed-ENU score.

loo_macro_improvement.criterion: The arithmetic mean of four held-route LOO scores improves by at least 0.05 m versus the arithmetic mean baseline score.

individual_worsening_limit.criterion: No held-route LOO diagnostic score may worsen by more than 0.10 m.

stretch_0_782_reachability.criterion: Applying the single full-cohort common median only as an offline diagnostic must produce both macro and target-route fixed-ENU scores <=0.782 m; no corrected coordinate or native candidate is created.

forbidden_actions: fit, apply, select, or deploy a truth-derived correction
rewrite or tune the sealed candidate
reopen or rematerialize the Phase44 archive
use device WLS, precomputed result/submission coordinates, or inferred coordinates as inference inputs
use truth speed, truth-derived heading, or truth-derived attitude
execution_order: commit and push this freeze JSON before any Phase45 truth read
commit and push evaluator source, focused tests, and evaluator manifest with this freeze hash
verify Phase44 freeze/result/materialization, Phase43 seal, and every candidate/raw/truth hash
in one process read each pinned candidate, Phase44 materialized truth, and raw IMU exactly once; never open archive
compute fixed ENU residual diagnostics, orientation/speed bins, and diagnostic-only LOO common-median scores
publish atomic output result and manifest, then checked-in result/docs/README
run focused tests and leave worktree clean
do not open validation or holdout in Phase45
decision_rule: The frozen route cohort, residual frame, speed/orientation labels, LOO estimator, numeric gates, and 0.782 reachability rule are immutable before truth reads. This phase never authorizes native correction or validation; a no-go records the strongest residual structure and exactly one next source-supported raw physical factor, while a diagnostic-go only authorizes planning of that raw-only mechanism for a later phase.
